notes.title: Release day is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42080973/9e7230d10aa92c5325c4dc5bf1c378d8636039f4.png[/img]

Today i release STAR MATH a game i have worked on for over 2 years, the vision is to make a game that's not only fun but also will benefit the player. I learned a lot myself on the way too, things like the collatz conjecture and also things that make no sense to me like the fact that 0 factorial is 1?! This games is for adults and kids, you can enable kids mode in the options, if the game does well i hope to do some free updates in the future. for now please enjoy the game and thank you in advance for anybody who takes the time to review the game.

Blessings
KingsGuard
